nodes.text: My head hurts.
Where... am I?
I remember logging in.
A message. A warning.
Then-
Everything went dark.
This place... it does not feel real.
Or maybe... it feels too real.
Someone brought me here.
And I need to figure out why.
Before it is too late.
The room shifts again.
Same stone. Same silence.
Those markers are waiting for answers.
This place checks what I know before it opens the next path.
I need to read carefully.
Guessing will only make this harder.
So this is how it works.
Those markers were not random.
Each one tested what I would trust.
What I would ignore.
And what I would check first.
More paths. More traps.
Nothing here is placed by accident.
If something looks harmless...
I still need to inspect it.
The air feels heavier here.
These guardians are not guarding doors.
They are guarding habits.
Weak passwords. Reused passwords. Missing second factors.
If I need to type a password here, it must be fictional.
No real secrets. Not in a place built to test me.
I need to remember the first fictional password exactly.
The final guardian may ask for proof that I remember it.
This chamber is infected.
Those things are not just wandering.
I cannot fight malware head-on.
I can block when it strikes, then reach the scanner angel.
Wrong answers still hurt too.
Reach each angel. Quarantine the malware zone by zone.
